changelog.title: CLH Labs Fixed
changelog.description: Fixed filesystem bugs in CLH-001 through CLH-008. All labs now use correct flat structure with children arrays for LinuxTerminal.js compatibility.

changelog.title: Spy-Themed Content
changelog.description: CLH labs now feature immersive spy/espionage content: OPERATION SILENT ECHO, classified intel, dead drops, handler communications, and hidden files to discover.

changelog.title: DevOps Learning Path
changelog.description: Added devops-fundamentals learning path with 9 modules covering Git, Agile, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

changelog.title: LinuxTerminal.js Engine
changelog.description: Deployed comprehensive Linux terminal simulator engine (1,856 lines) supporting 40+ commands, pipes, redirection, and virtual filesystem.
